purpose: Conditional post-gate edit specifications for the four clearest wrong-page ownership cases. These are plans only; protected ranking pages remain unchanged until their gates and finalized GSC review.

evidence.crawl: All audited owners are reachable and have no broken internal targets.
evidence.anchors: Broad city anchors point cleanly to intended city owners; regional hub anchors are separated from exact city-owner anchors.
evidence.freshness: General owners and competing URLs share 2026-10-04 sitemap lastmod dates.
evidence.conclusion: Wrong-page visibility is not explained by crawl depth, broken links, broad anchor leakage, freshness, or raw internal-link count. Primary remaining hypotheses are owner-page intent concentration, overbuilt structure, regional/sibling semantic overlap, and historical Google query association.

Upland.decisionRule: If the general Upland owner gains clear finalized ownership by the gate, do not rewrite. If laundry still leads broad intent, make a surgical boundary correction rather than a full page rebuild.
conditionalChanges: Keep title, H1, canonical, 909 phone, request form, qualification rules and dedicated laundry handoff.
Keep one city-intent opening, appliance categories, simple process, access/local section, qualification limits, FAQ, commercial/recurring path and request.
Merge any overlapping removal/recycling explanation into one local alternatives section if duplication remains.
On the washer/dryer page, preserve breadcrumb and explicit handoff to the general owner; only narrow additional broad-appliance wording if finalized query data still shows leakage.

Fontana.decisionRule: Because the owner is already relatively concise and strongly linked, first test regional/sibling intent boundaries. Do not automatically cut the city page.
conditionalChanges: Preserve the 10-section city owner unless finalized data shows structural weakness.
If Southern California hub still outranks the Fontana owner, reduce Fontana-specific broad language on the regional hub while keeping a clear link to the city owner.
If stove/oven or Rialto laundry still receives broad Fontana impressions, narrow only the offending generic city wording while keeping specialty/local intent intact.
Keep local Fontana access, appliance qualification, official bulky-item alternative, FAQ and request flow.

Phoenix.decisionRule: If the broad Phoenix owner remains weak on Oct 9, this is the strongest immediate candidate for competitor-model structural concentration.
conditionalChanges: Reduce 19 H2 sections toward roughly 7-9 distinct sections.
Keep one Phoenix city-intent intro, simple 3-step process, appliance categories/qualification, access/local City alternative, commercial/recurring path, FAQ and request.
Merge overlapping Phoenix city-vs-metro, search-intent, route, neighborhood and preparation sections instead of deleting useful facts.
Preserve 602-726-7552, canonical, request form, official City of Phoenix alternative and direct Phoenix Metro handoff.
Do not weaken the refrigerator page unless finalized broad-query ownership confirms it is still stealing the generic city query.

Fresno.decisionRule: If neighboring city pages continue to surface for broad Fresno intent, concentrate the Fresno owner and narrow Fresno-targeting language on siblings rather than adding more content.
conditionalChanges: Reduce owner structure toward city intent, request/process, appliance categories/qualification, access/local cleanup alternative, commercial/multifamily path, FAQ, request and nearby-market handoff.
Merge ZIP/neighborhood/nearby-route overlap so Fresno remains the clear city entity.
Preserve the strong Fresno recycling signal, 310 contact routing, form and official local cleanup alternative.
Keep Clovis/Sanger/Selma pages focused on their own cities and Fresno County relationships, not Fresno-city broad intent.
